steps.description: The records describe type variables, constants, functions and lists. You use apply to follow substitutions and free_vars to find variable names within a type.
unify applies existing substitutions before comparing its arguments. It returns for equal types or binds a variable after checking that the replacement excludes that variable.
Function types unify their parameter and result components. List types unify their elements; the first tests print bindings to Int and Bool.
